x-help.fr: Un changement compte pour les nouveaux tampons ; ceux déjà donnés restent.
x-help.ar: التغيير يخص الأختام الجديدة فقط؛ الأختام السابقة تبقى.

stampsNeeded.description: Stamps needed for one reward ("10 commandes = 1 café offert"). A change applies to new stamps only: stamps already given stay.

x-help.fr: Telle que les clients la lisent, par exemple « 1 café offert ».

reward.description: The reward, as customers and staff read it. French required; Arabic and English fall back to French.

minOrderTotal.description: Smallest order total, in millimes, that earns a stamp (0 = every order). Counter stamps are the staff's choice.
